influences.name: Moody Blues
influences.context: My dad had this big home stereo with an 8-track player, and even though he wasn't a country fan at all, he loved music. I remember him putting on the Moody Blues, Pink Floyd, and the Eagles while he was working around the house. Those sounds filled the whole place.

influences.name: Pink Floyd
influences.context: I remember him putting on the Moody Blues, Pink Floyd, and the Eagles while he was working around the house. Those sounds filled the whole place. I didn't know who any of those bands were at the time, but I remember the feeling of it.

influences.name: Eagles

influences.name: Johnny Cash
influences.context: He had a way of telling dark, honest stories without losing the humanity in them. That balance is something I really respect. A lot of my music leans into the shadows and the weight of what people carry, and he was a master at that long before anybody called it 'dark' anything.

influences.name: Chino Moreno
influences.context: I am such a massive fan of Chino Moreno and his melodic tendency and style. Successfully achieving even a small portion of that Chino magic is often a measurement of how much I'll enjoy my own music.

influences.name: Deftones
influences.context: I would absolutely LOVE to hear a Crosses or Deftones remix of pretty much any of the tracks on the album.

influences.name: Marc Bolan
influences.context: There was of course that early tour with Marc Bolan, which was a real highlight.

influences.name: ZZ Top
influences.context: For Big Trouble in Little China, the sound designer used a temporary score in the beginning. He used a ZZ Top song, "Just Got Paid." I loved it, so with that inspiring me, I copied the beat, and added my own stuff.
